name: Duke Pre-College Programs (High School)
org: Duke University, Office of the Provost
what_you_do: Duke runs residential summer academic programs on its campus. They are for high school students. Students must be at least 14 to attend.
who_can_apply: High school students in current grades 9 to 12 who are at least 14 by the first day and have finished one year of high school. You should have a GPA of 3.0 or higher. (The page also lists middle school programs for grades 6 to 8.)
pay_detail: 2027 residential fee: $6,030. Enrollment deposit: $500 before April 2, 2027, or $1,500 after April 1. Airport shuttle $45 each way; extra nights $120 each.
duration: Three sessions; 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 3, 2026
deadline_text: Registration opens in December 2026 (no exact day posted). 2027 session dates are not posted as of Nov 3, 2026. Final payment is due 30 days before your session starts.
how_to_apply: Join the information request list on the Duke Pre-College page to get an email when registration opens. You register in the Duke Pre-College Student Portal.
notes: 2027 session dates and courses were not posted as of Nov 3, 2026. Check back in December.
